reden: No. While the report flags replay/validation issues in PhiFactory’s claim flows (missing nonce, quantity/imageURI not signed, and lack of already-claimed checks), it does not mention that PhiFactory.signatureClaim ignores the encoded chainId and can be called directly to bypass the chain-bound repack, enabling cross-chain signature replay. The root cause and fix (binding/repacking chainId) are different; fixing the reported issues would not fix the cross-chain replay described.
